product_overview: Esfyq Portfolio is a single-page creative portfolio showcasing an introduction, skills, selected projects, and a contact form. The experience is chapter-based with fixed navigation and an animated 3D background that responds as the user scrolls.
core_goals: Learn about Esfyq through the hero and about sections
Browse featured projects and open external project links
Send a message through the contact form
Jump between portfolio chapters using fixed navigation
Experience the animated 3D background while scrolling through the page

features.name: Hero Genesis Section
features.description: Introduces the portfolio with a headline, supporting text, and a call to action that leads into the work section.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the hero headline and subtitle -> Click View My Work to jump to the projects section -> See the scroll indicator below the call to action

features.name: About Craft Section
features.description: Presents the creator bio and skill-focused glassmorphic cards.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the about section -> View the bio content -> View the skill cards

features.name: Projects Artifacts Section
features.description: Shows a curated list of portfolio projects with access to live demos and source code links for active projects.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the projects section -> Browse the project list -> Open a live demo for an active project -> Open the GitHub repository for an active project

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Lets visitors submit their name, email, and message to reach out.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact section -> Fill in the name field -> Fill in the email field -> Fill in the message field -> Submit the contact form -> See success feedback after submission
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact section -> Fill in the name field -> Leave the email or message content incomplete -> Submit the contact form -> See validation feedback

features.name: Chapter Navigation
features.description: Provides fixed navigation for moving between the portfolio chapters and changing the site theme.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a chapter navigation link -> Jump to the selected section -> Continue navigating between chapters
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile navigation menu -> Collapse the mobile navigation menu -> Toggle the theme between dark and light modes

features.name: 3D Model Background
features.description: Displays a loading screen while the 3D scene initializes and updates the Porsche model background as the user scrolls.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Wait for the loading screen to complete -> See the 3D model background appear -> Scroll through the page to observe camera movement in the scene

routes.description: Portfolio homepage with stacked chapter sections and 3D background

features.name: Hero Genesis Section
features.description: First chapter introducing Esfyq portfolio with headline, subtitle, and CTA
user_interactions: View hero headline and subtitle on page load
Click View My Work button to scroll to projects section

features.name: About Craft Section
features.description: Second chapter showcasing skills and bio with glassmorphic cards
user_interactions: View skill cards and bio content

features.name: Projects Artifacts Section

user_interactions: Click live demo or GitHub links on active project

user_interactions: Fill name email and message fields

features.name: Chapter Navigation

features.name: 3D Model Background

Scroll through chapters to see camera movement on 3D scene

known_limitations.issue: Contact form submission is client-side only with no backend persistence
known_limitations.impact: Form data is not sent to a server or email service

known_limitations.issue: GSAP imported in Quote.jsx but may be missing from dependencies
known_limitations.impact: Potential runtime error if Quote component is rendered

known_limitations.issue: Horizontal scroll and camera movement may be broken per known bugs
known_limitations.impact: Users may not reach all four chapters or see scroll-driven 3D camera
